from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib
home=Path.home()
prior=home/'.local/share/prediction-project-executor/worktrees/DEV-PRED-RO-AUDIT-20261005-E003/audit-output-e003/runtime.json'
data=json.loads(prior.read_text())
alias={'supervisor.py':'supervisor','candidate_dispatch.py':'dispatch','model_quality_gate.py':'gate','astra_autonomous_review.py':'auto_review','astra_review_wake.py':'review_wake','build_wake.py':'build','measurement_wake.py':'measure','ai_response.py':'scout','candidate_reporting.py':'report'}
compact={'drift':[alias.get(Path(p).name,Path(p).name) for p in data['production_source_drift']],'bad_pins':[alias.get(p,p) for p in data['pin_mismatches']]}
prod=home/'prediction_research_prod'
config=json.loads((prod/'knowledge/codex_runtime/CONFIG.json').read_text())
compact['missing_pins']=[alias.get(n,n) for n in data['pin_mismatches'] if ('supervisor_sha256' if n=='supervisor.py' else n+'_sha256') not in config]
out=Path.cwd()/'audit-output-e005'
out.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
(out/'details.json').write_text(json.dumps({'compact':compact,'runtime_evidence':data},indent=2))
print('AUDIT_ALIGNMENT '+json.dumps(compact,separators=(',',':')),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1 if compact['drift'] or compact['bad_pins'] else 0)
